Product Profile
CR Dhan 101, also known as Ankit, is a 110-day variety released by ICAR-NRRI in 2014. Featuring medium height and mediumslender grains, it is specifically tailored for irrigated upland ecosystems prone to recurrent water deficits. Notably, CR Dhan 101 demonstrates resistance against major diseases and pests. On average, this variety yields 4 tons per hectare.
